items.name: accordion
items.description: Composable disclosure items with a measured 200ms ease-out height animation.

items.name: alert
items.description: Inline status messages with shared card surfaces and default/destructive variants.

items.name: aspect-ratio
items.description: A full-width box that preserves its width-to-height ratio as its parent resizes.

items.name: avatar
items.description: Circular identity images with loading/error fallbacks and shared small/default/large sizes.

items.name: badge
items.description: The same compact label and six visual variants as the web badge.

items.name: button-group
items.description: Joined buttons, labels, and separators with horizontal or vertical composition.

items.name: button
items.description: Displays the validation border and ring.

items.name: card
items.description: Card surfaces, spacing, title typography, and footer treatment match the web renderer.

items.name: checkbox
items.description: A composable checkbox with checked, unchecked, and indeterminate states.

items.name: collapsible
items.description: Expandable content with controlled/uncontrolled state and accessible expanded-state announcements.

items.name: input-group
items.description: Text entry with composable addons, actions, and one shared focus/validation outline.

items.name: input
items.description: Native text entry using value/onChangeText; label with accessibilityLabel.

items.name: label
items.description: Text labels with the web typography and explicit native control activation.

items.name: progress
items.description: Linear and circular progress with clamped values and an indeterminate state.

items.name: radio-group
items.description: Single-choice fields with controlled state and accessible, individually disabled options.

items.name: separator
items.description: Decorative hairline divider; use a parent with height for vertical separators.

items.name: skeleton
items.description: Loading placeholder using the web two-second opacity pulse; reduced motion disables the pulse.

items.name: spinner
items.description: The web loader's SVG path and one-second linear rotation, with reduced-motion support.

items.name: switch
items.description: Compact switches with the same track, thumb, and checked colors as the web renderer.

items.name: tabs
items.description: Content tabs with selected-state styling, horizontal/vertical layouts, and optional panel preservation.

items.name: textarea
items.description: Multiline native input with the same validation and focus treatment as Input.

items.name: toggle-group
items.description: Single or multiple selection with spaced or joined controls.

items.name: toggle
items.description: A persistent pressed button, with web-matched sizes, colors, and 150ms transitions.

items.name: lib/canvas
items.description: Platform-independent drop intent; each renderer supplies its own gesture handling.

items.name: lib/context
items.description: Contexts for compound native components fail clearly outside their root.

items.name: lib/controllable
items.description: Controlled-or-uncontrolled state. Pass the controlled value (or `undefined`), the uncontrolled default, and an optional change callback that fires in both modes.

items.name: lib/data-table-adapter
items.description: The contract the data table parts render against. `<DataTable>` accepts any object that satisfies it, so the parts are independent of where the rows, sorting, filtering, and paging come from. The built-in engine in `@/lib/table` satisfies it directly and is the default adapter. To drive the parts from another source (a server-side query, a different table library, a store), implement this interface over that source and pass the result to `<DataTable table={...}>`. Columns are data only: the adapter exposes ids, labels, sorting, visibility, and filtering. Headers and cells are composed in JSX on the page with `DataTableHead` / `DataTableCell`, keyed by column id.

items.name: lib/focus
items.description: Pointer focus on the web must not show a keyboard focus ring.

items.name: lib/history
items.description: Undo/redo state for any immutable value. `set` records a history entry unless `{ commit: false }` is passed (live drags, typing); `checkpoint` snapshots the present before such a sequence so one undo restores it.

items.name: lib/motion
items.description: Expo SDKs before CSS boxShadow support still animate shadows on the UI thread.

items.name: lib/presence
items.description: Mount hidden panels only after first use, and optionally preserve their local state.

items.name: lib/row-layout
items.description: Rows-and-columns layout helpers for the Canvas primitive. A layout is `Row[]`, each row a list of items with a `width` (flex-grow weight). Drops above/below an item create a row, beside it a column; the resize handle shifts width between neighbours. Shared by the form builder and the widgets page.

items.name: lib/table
items.description: A small headless table engine: column definitions, sorting, global and per-column filtering with faceted counts, pagination, row selection, and column visibility. No external dependencies.

items.name: lib/theme
items.description: Multiply alpha just as Tailwind's color/opacity utilities do.

items.name: lib/time
items.description: "3 minutes ago", "yesterday", "in 2 weeks"; "just now" under a minute.

items.name: lib/tokens
items.description: Canonical design values shared by the web stylesheet and the native renderer. Colors remain in OKLCH for CSS; native receives their sRGB equivalents.
